value.rationale: A natural compressed experimental observable, the complete weighted replacement kernel, fails to determine the sign of rare-cooperator fixation in the smallest possible same-kernel independent-site model. The all-intensity reversal and minimality distinguish this from a numerical parameter example and motivate co-occupation data for multiplayer evolutionary inference.
